fields.name: not save data
fields.meaning: Work area the game uses while running (screen and text buffers); rewritten constantly during play and never loaded as a save
fields.evidence: everyday play changes it without any save action; load code never reads it

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Fixed text 'Kiss yori WS EDT' marking the memory as formatted; a mismatch at power-on reformats the save area and the game reports the save area was broken
fields.evidence: code f000:0466 compares with ROM f000:0456, f000:030B writes it; boot reads it; blank-memory message observed

fields.name: slot-used bits
fields.meaning: One bit per save: bits 0-3 = files 1-4, bit 4 = AUTO file, bit 5 = player profile; a save is only offered when its bit is set
fields.evidence: code f000:0571 sets, f000:0504 clears, f000:0466 tests; seen 0x20 (profile), 0x30 (+AUTO), 0x31 (+file 1), 0x33 (+file 2), 0x37 (+file 3)

fields.name: file 1 checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 384 little-endian 16-bit words of the file 1 block, kept to 16 bits
fields.evidence: code f000:0648 write path, f000:04AE check path; recomputed on all 274 memory images

fields.name: file 2 checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 384 little-endian 16-bit words of the file 2 block, kept to 16 bits
fields.evidence: code f000:0648/f000:04AE; recomputed on all 274 memory images

fields.name: file 3 checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 384 little-endian 16-bit words of the file 3 block, kept to 16 bits
fields.evidence: code f000:0648/f000:04AE; proven on the file-3 save (0xC7B3)

fields.name: file 4 checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 384 little-endian 16-bit words of the file 4 block, kept to 16 bits
fields.evidence: code f000:0648/f000:04AE; zero while empty in every image

fields.name: AUTO file checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 384 little-endian 16-bit words of the AUTO file block, kept to 16 bits
fields.evidence: code f000:0648/f000:04AE; recomputed on all 274 memory images

fields.name: profile checksum
fields.meaning: Byte sum (8-bit) of the 32 bytes 1F20-1F3F
fields.evidence: code f000:06D0 write, f000:04E5 check; recomputed on all 274 memory images

fields.name: shared settings checksum
fields.meaning: Byte sum (8-bit) of the 36 bytes 1F40-1F63; checked whenever any file is loaded
fields.evidence: code f000:0670/06E2 write, f000:04C8 check; recomputed on all 274 memory images

fields.name: last file saved
fields.meaning: Number (1-4) of the last file saved by hand; automatic saves do not change it
fields.evidence: code f000:0581 writes, f000:04FC reads; seen 1, 2, 3 after saving each file

fields.name: file 1
fields.meaning: Saved game in file 1 (field layout below, offsets relative to the file start); files 2-4 follow at 1320, 1620, 1920
fields.evidence: code f000:0571 base 1020 + file*0x300; each file saved and reloaded in play

fields.name: file 2
fields.meaning: Same layout as file 1
fields.evidence: saved on a later day (7/23) and reloaded

fields.name: file 3
fields.meaning: Same layout as file 1
fields.evidence: saved and checksum-proven

fields.name: file 4
fields.meaning: Same layout as file 1; still empty in every image

fields.name: AUTO file
fields.meaning: Saved automatically by the game (seen at the start of each day and at event checkpoints); a save into file 1-4 copies this block unchanged
fields.evidence: code f000:05B0 fills it from memory, f000:05A5 copies it; file 1/2/3 each equalled it when saved

fields.name: profile: birthday
fields.meaning: Birth month and day (1/1 in the natural saves); on first setup the game takes them from the console owner birthday when valid, else 1/1
fields.evidence: code f000:030B default path with month/day range checks; profile screen shows 1/1

fields.name: profile: blood type
fields.meaning: 1 = A (shown as A-type)
fields.evidence: code f000:03B5 default 1-4 from console owner data; profile screen shows A-type

fields.name: profile: hobby
fields.meaning: 0x0A in the natural saves, with reading chosen
fields.evidence: profile screen shows reading

fields.name: profile: unknown
fields.meaning: 0, 1 in the natural saves; set when the profile is confirmed
fields.evidence: profile-confirm diff

fields.name: profile: player name
fields.meaning: Same name as in the files (family 5 + given 5 kana numbers); default written at setup
fields.evidence: code f000:030B default, f000:0685 copies memory 06DB; profile-confirm diff

fields.name: profile: unused
fields.meaning: Zero; counted in the profile checksum
fields.evidence: code f000:0685 never writes it

fields.name: shared settings: block
fields.meaning: Memory 042F-0435, saved with every file save; first byte 4 after the first AUTO save. On loading, bit 0 of the first byte and the top 2 bits of the last byte are kept from memory
fields.evidence: code f000:05F8 saves, f000:0822 loads with masked merges; first-AUTO-save diff

fields.name: shared settings: options
fields.meaning: Memory 06D7, 06D8-06D9, 06DA, 06E6, 0156, 0154; defaults 0,1,2,3,0,1,1 written at setup, unchanged by play so far
fields.evidence: code f000:030B defaults, f000:0603 saves, f000:083C loads

fields.name: shared settings: unused
fields.meaning: Zero; counted in the checksum at 101D
fields.evidence: code f000:0571 never writes it

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written; zero
fields.evidence: zero in every one of the 274 images
